post.caption: The Getty's ancient gem was modern. The Getty owns an amethyst carved with the head of Mark Antony. In 1968, scholar John Boardman praised it as a fine ancient work. The Getty bought it in 2001. In 2009, it went on show as an ancient work. Then an expert in Berlin recognized it from a plaster impression. The carver Calandrelli's notebook listed the same Mark Antony. He carved it for Prince Poniatowski around 1820. Curator Kenneth Lapatin counted three smoking guns in all. The prince's collection grew to more than 2,600 gems called ancient.
